sources.name: Avalanche Public C-Chain RPC
sources.cadence: 10-second cached live pulse plus hourly audited snapshot

sources.name: AvaCache daily Avalanche parquet
sources.limitation: Daily files are independently reconciled to the C-Chain tip and are not a substitute for traces.

sources.name: Euler EVK Avalanche factory and UtilsLens
sources.limitation: Factory provenance is not risk curation. Only active borrow-enabled vaults are displayed, balances are gross and non-additive, and missing USD prices remain null.

sources.name: Silo Avalanche deployment registry, factory, and SiloLens
sources.cadence: hourly fixed-block observation; pinned registry refreshed on releases
sources.limitation: The pinned registry includes legacy, expired, dust, and potentially impaired permissionless markets. APR is preserved as APR, utilization may exceed 100%, and missing USD prices remain null.

sources.name: DeFiLlama TVL API
sources.cadence: 60-second cached current observation plus hourly audited snapshot

sources.name: DeFiLlama Dimensions API
sources.cadence: 60-second cached current observation plus hourly audited snapshot
sources.limitation: Adapter coverage differs by protocol and may be revised after publication.

sources.name: DeFiLlama Yields API
sources.limitation: Pool TVL is not equivalent to supplied or borrowed value unless the adapter exposes those fields.

sources.name: DefiLlama Coins API
sources.cadence: hourly current prices and daily historical observations
sources.limitation: Liquidations use the end-of-UTC-day token price rather than the exact block price. Missing prices stay unavailable and are never zero-filled.

sources.name: CoinGecko market data API
sources.limitation: The unauthenticated endpoint is rate limited; CoinPaprika is the automatic fallback.

sources.name: CoinPaprika market data API
sources.cadence: 60-second cached live pulse plus hourly audited snapshot

sources.name: RWA.xyz public asset pages
sources.limitation: Only exact Avalanche C-Chain token rows are scored. Public-page structure can change, so parser failures become unavailable checks and never overwrite source-of-record values.

sources.name: Avalanche Builder Hub Metrics API
sources.limitation: Only metrics with definitions matching the local parquet derivation are scored. Active-address and contract-creation definitions are intentionally not compared.

sources.name: Avalanche Builder Hub Data API
sources.limitation: Supply fields are current cumulative observations, not a historical daily series. P-, C-, and X-Chain burn values are reported separately and summed only for the displayed Primary Network fee-burn total.
